pro_course_detail.title: Californian Accent Course / American Pronunciation Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to speak English even more like an American? Then you have found the right teacher. I specialize in pronunciation and will show you how to pronounce English with MY accent. If you are an actor, businessperson, interpreter, teacher, diplomat, or just wanting to expand your ability to mimic Americans for whatever reason, these classes are for you. These classes are primarily for advanced speakers that already have a high intermediate or advanced ability in English phonology.  I WILL NOT TEACH YOU THE 'CLEAREST' ENGLISH! I teach you how native speakers where I'm from REALLY speak (NOT THE SURFER/VALLEY GIRL/BRO ACCENT!), rather than an unnatural, prescribed, international, or 'newscaster' pronunciation. Be ready for a challenge, there will be many surprises. 
This course consists of 4 chapters that teach and have practice for every technique used by those I grew up with when we speak to each other. 
The course is based on the book 'Rhythm and Intonation of American English' by Amanda Lillet. As we learn the different theories in the book, we will do additional practice with my own materials for the section covered in the book with the aid of my own phonemic writing system. Although we will go linearly through the course, you will learn and practice things that are covered and emphasized in previous and following sections. Once we have finished the first three chapters, we can do a wide range of activities and be creative and personalized in how we practice that will continually change your accent to be ever more Californian. 
My other goals as a tutor are to be your native speaker connection, answer any questions you might have, share resources, encourage you, give you study tips, teach you slang/idioms/expressions, and get you to continue improving your abilities with English. You will receive access to over $100 of materials just for taking one class with me. I will also share with you other resources to practice. 
We will use Italki classroom! Not Zoom!

pro_course_detail.title: EnglishMaxx / American English for Advanced Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you feel stuck at your current English level and are feeling a plateau? I will show you how to bring your English to the next level, from B1 to B2, B2 to C1, and C1 to C2.  Hint: YOU CAN'T KEEP DOING THE SAME THING! I will show you what techniques to implement to start drastically improving your English. You will learn what you should be doing by yourself and with teachers so you can effectively study by yourself and know what to do with teachers, like me. 
We will mainly be doing Speaking and Grammar classes.
Speaking classes consist in speaking about advanced topics that I already have or generated by ChatGPT, speaking about or narrating content you have watched, and me speaking to you in a more advanced way. I have many technological resources that we can use to make personalized classes. These classes should be fun, creative, and customized to your preferences. You need to watch shows, see movies, listen to podcasts, read books and then be excited to talk to me about them and answer questions that AI generates. 

Grammar classes will be literally THE OPPOSITE of traditional schools. I will make you a large list of all the grammar rules you need to know with links. We will pick 1 grammar to work on at a time. You will read the rule aloud to me and we will read many example sentences and integrate AI if we need more. We will then do EXCLUSIVELY ORAL grammar exercises with ABSOLUTELY NO WRITING!!! using websites, books, ChatGPT, and Docs. 
Would you like to speak with a native speaker with a clear accent? Let's meet and talk about whatever you'd like. You let me know what you would like out of the conversation and we will do exactly that.
Would you like to learn modern slang that Americans use? I have an unpublished list of slang that you will not find anywhere else. Learning these will help you understand Americans easier, impress and make them laugh, and show that you care about our language and how we speak.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking refinement.  Accent, pronunciation, and vocal expression.
pro_course_detail.description: This class is focused on language expression refinement.  Often times people learning a new language will earn a certain proficiency, but stop there, without refining their grammar, intonation and vocal expression to a professional level.  Speaking refinement is the essential next step for sounding professional in any higher-level career opportunity.  As a person who is in management, in higher-end sales, or in a refined field, such as medical, teaching, or business, a certain level of professionalism is mandatory.  Learn the nuances in language, and be able to not just speak to be understood, but speak in such a way that you present confidence and professionalism through fine-tuning not just what you you say, but how you say it.  This will involve exercises on pronunciation, syllable emphasis, stress and intonation (and help you sound more credible as a native speaker!).   This class will help you transition from being able to express ideas as an entry-level employee, to being able to express thoughts like a respected, well-versed manager/owner.  Please let me know what career field you are in, so I can personalize the lesson for you, and offer targeted vocabulary which compliments your specialty.

This class would involve interactive lessons designed to engage young minds in the joys of learning.  Whether a student is quiet and reserved, or playful and energetic, every learner has a path to success.  Students and parents can choose which lesson they would like to cover that day.  Some sample topics for beginner-intermediate includes, greetings, talking about family, talking about food, talking about school, talking about farm animals, talking about wildlife, talking about the seasons, and talking about clothing.  Beginners will engage in various activities to learn the names of various nouns and actions.  Intermediate learners will begin to learn how to use nouns and verbs in sentences.  More advanced learners will begin how to express thoughts in spontaneous conversation.  Some students prefer learning through songs and games and others prefer to learn through focused conversation.  The most popular class is a reading and comprehension class.  Please let me know of your student's level, learning preferences and topic interests, so I can personalize it for him/her!

It is strongly recommended that kids ages 3-9 are booked for 30-minute classes only as their attention spans are shorter and they do better in shorter segments.

Please be sure to select the kids class if the class is for children under the age of 14.  Older children may be able to switch into intermediate material.  Levels for the student can be determined after the first lesson.  I look forward to working with you.

- CV and resume review (only during our class).

pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for those who want to perfect their American English pronunciation to sound as native-like as possible. 

Here is the basic format for each lesson in this course:
--short review of previous lesson and assessment of progress
--step by step study of that day's vowel, diphthong, or consonant in American English
--use of mouth diagrams to form proper tongue placement
--repetition exercises uses words, phrases, and sentences containing the target sounds

**Self-study is the most important part of making major progress. Each lesson will include self-study exercises to put into practice what we learned.**
